description: Projects a pe/pm is scoped to, resolved server-side instead of the client fetching every jfb_project_members row and filtering in JS. Joins jfb_projects to jfb_project_members and returns the projects where an active membership row's email matches p_email (case/whitespace-insensitive). Cross-project roles (director/admin) don't use this view -- they still read jfb_projects directly for the full list.
direct_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name, p.project_code, p.client_name, p.work_type, p.is_active, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.volume_goal, p.primary_measure, p.site_city, p.site_state, p.is_tsca_zone_tracking, p.is_soil_type, p.is_pipe_tracking FROM usdf.jfb_projects p JOIN usdf.jfb_project_members m ON m.project_id = p.id WHERE m.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND lower(trim(m.email)) = lower(trim(p_email)) ORDER BY p.name

parameters.name: p_email
parameters.description: The logged-in pe/pm's token email, matched against jfb_project_members.email.

columns.name: project_code
columns.description: Project number shown on the dashboard card (e.g. #182601).

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Whether the project itself is active.

columns.name: primary_measure
columns.description: Primary measure used for progress tracking.

columns.name: is_tsca_zone_tracking
columns.description: Whether TSCA zone tracking is enabled for this project.

columns.name: is_soil_type
columns.description: Whether soil type tracking is enabled for this project.

columns.name: is_pipe_tracking
columns.description: Whether pipe tracking is enabled for this project.
